verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical. In both, the diamond photo mosaic no longer bleeds off the left edge: a thin white strip with stray edge artifacts shows there, so the collage looks shifted rather than rebuilt for the wider canvas. Everything else is a near-copy of the original with the same proportions: headline, rule, body copy, vertical URL and the brown address and date diamonds are all intact and readable, and the bottom text block has a wider left margin than the original.
